title: Unramifiedness at a point from maximal ideals and residue fields
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] locally of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], let $x\in X$ and $s=f(x)$, and put $A=\mathcal O_{S,s}$ and $B=\mathcal O_{X,x}$ with maximal ideals $\mathfrak m_A$ and $\mathfrak m_B$. The following are equivalent: (i) there is an open subscheme $V\subseteq X$ containing $x$ such that $f|_V:V\to S$ is unramified [def-weil-unramified-morphism]; (ii) $\mathfrak m_AB=\mathfrak m_B$ for the actual local homomorphism $f_x^\sharp:A\to B$, and its induced residue-field extension $\kappa(x)/\kappa(s)$ [def-weil-residue-field] is finite separable algebraic [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension]. Here $\mathfrak m_AB$ is the ideal of $B$ generated by the images of the elements of $\mathfrak m_A$.

source.place: Tag 02GF, lemma-unramified-at-point, equivalence (1) with (6), lines 7874–7930; unramified at a point means an unramified open neighbourhood.

proof.text: Assume (i), and choose an open neighbourhood V of x on which f|_V is unramified. By the existing implication from unramified to formally unramified, the restricted morphism is formally unramified. Its actual stalk map at x is therefore formally unramified, and the stalk maximal-ideal/residue criterion above gives m_A B = m_B and that kappa(x)/kappa(s) is finite separable algebraic. This is exactly (ii), with the equality interpreted through the actual stalk homomorphism.

source.place: Tag 02GF, (1) implies (6), together with Mathlib stalkMap and local criterion

proof.text: Assume (ii). Apply the stalk criterion above to the actual local ring map f_x^sharp to obtain formal unramifiedness of that map. Since f is locally of finite type, the existing stalk-to-neighbourhood theorem supplies an open V containing x such that V to X to S is formally unramified. Local finite type is inherited by the restriction V to S, so the locally-finite-type/formally-unramified criterion makes V to S unramified. Hence (i) holds.

lean.statement: theorem unramified_neighbourhood_iff_maximalIdeal_residue {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType f] (x : X) : (∃ V : X.Opens, x ∈ V ∧ IsUnramified (V.ι ≫ f)) ↔ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (S.presheaf.stalk (f x))).map (f.stalkMap x).hom = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x) ∧ (f.residueFieldMap x).hom.Finite ∧ @Algebra.IsSeparable (S.residueField (f x)) (X.residueField x) _ _ (f.residueFieldMap x).hom.toAlgebra
